en: A historical black-and-white photograph showing a large, formal gathering in a public square. There are military officers, troops in formation, and groups of civilians. The main building in the background is neoclassical, flying a large flag, and in front of it stands a prominent statue. The cobblestone square and scale suggest an important civic location. The lower right corner contains printed text: 'NYBLIN 1918'.
